reason: This is a fundamental behavioral change to the core content pipeline (Updating/Updated no longer fire during creation, plus new Created/Creating semantics and obsoleted UpdatingItem/PublishingItem properties), which will silently break any first- or third-party module/handler relying on the old semantics unless it also implements the new Creating/Created events.
